newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free-mkt grain at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free-mkt grain at tender.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted licences to export 263,500 tonnes of free-market soft wheat to non-EU countries with a maximum rebate of 11.47 Ecus per tonne, European grain traders said.
The EU also granted the export of 301,000 tonnes of free-market barley with a maximum rebate of 28.47 Ecus per tonne, they said.
The EU also granted the export of 10,000 tonnes of free-market rye to non-EU countries with a maximum rebate of 34.98 Ecus per tonne.
The EU's grain panel also cleared the export of 1,400 tonnes of free-market oats to Switzerland at a maximum rebate of 26.94 Ecus per tonne, they said.
